plan: Drive: from Kuldo, about 29 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Kuldo FSR, Damsumlo FSR.
Park: 56.00387, -127.71234, pull off on Damsumlo FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 20 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,512 m, about 552 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 200 m E of the spot at 599 m (56.16961, -127.83394). Water: unnamed wetland 80 m S (estimate).
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-7, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-16, closures 2026-10-16.
R6M-moose-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-7: about 82 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
